listed_sector_signals.signal: Reference cited to a cement-industry energy-efficiency study (continuous cement production), but only as a bibliographic citation, not the paper's own application context
listed_sector_signals.quote:
“Analysis of 
Energy-Efficiency Opportunities for the Cement Industry in 
Shandong Province, China: A Case Study of 16 Cement Plants”

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Case-study consumer operates in brick manufacturing (ceramics-type thermal processing with a heat-treatment oven)
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
the Case Study of an industrial consumer 
which operates in the bricks manufacturing sub-sector will be 
presented.

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Brick Treatment/Heat Treatment Oven with near-continuous technological process operation (~8,160 h/year) and high natural-gas share
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
The Heat Treatment Oven (HTO) is the Significant Energy 
Use when it comes to Natural Gas consumption, being 
responsible for up to 51% of the entire equivalent energy 
consumption of the Organization.

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Reference cited on waste heat recovery in the ceramics industry
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
“A Review on Waste 
Heat Recovery from Exhaust in the Ceramics Industry”

one_line: An energy-management cost-of-opportunity analysis of unimplemented energy efficiency actions (water pumping VSD and heat recovery) for an industrial brick-manufacturing (ceramics-type) plant, with cement and ceramics only appearing as cited references.
